title: Traffic-Sliced Evaluation Safeguard with Hierarchical Rollback Heuristics
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a traffic-sliced evaluation guard that links model and config changes to targeted quality probes and a multi-stage rollback policy. For each staged rollout (canary or A/B), the system should run lightweight synthetic and real-user quality checks scoped to the affected cohorts (region, customer tier, route). Based on statistically-significant regressions and confidence levels, the controller should progress through an ordered mitigation path: 1) reduce traffic to affected variant, 2) route to a compatible model variant (e.g., lower-latency/quantized fallback or previous model), 3) full rollback and alert. This ticket covers design, implementation, end-to-end tests, dashboards, and an initial runbook for on-call/SEs.
acceptance_criteria: Per-cohort probes run automatically for any model/config change exposed to >0% staged traffic within the rollout window (config hooks integrated with rollout controller)
System emits a quality signal stream that includes: probe_id, cohort, baseline_metrics, current_metrics, p_value, delta_percent, sample_size, and suggested_action

Automated mitigation executes in three tiers with observable events: TRAFFIC_THROTTLE -> MODEL_FALLBACK -> FULL_ROLLBACK. Every mitigation must include an explainable reason string and unique correlation_id
False positive rate for automatic full rollback estimated <3% on historical simulation (run against past 6 months of changes); manual intervention allowed via 'pause-auto' flag
Dashboard tile shows cohort-level drift, current rollout fraction, mitigation history, and links to related PR/commit and eval artifacts
E2E test harness can simulate synthetic probe failures and verify the controller triggers the correct ordered mitigation and persists audit trail
implementation_notes: Hook points: integrate with rollout controller to subscribe to rollout events and cohort metadata (region, route, customer_tier)
Signal ingestion: small Kafka topic 'eval.signals' with compacted keys; probes push metrics periodically and on-change
Stat testing: use sequential probability ratio test (SPRT) for low-latency detection and bootstrap CIs for nonparametric metrics (e.g., reward-ranked quality)
Hysteresis: require regression sustained for two consecutive evaluation windows or p_value < 0.01 with min sample size to avoid flapping
Mitigations: implement a pluggable action executor that can call routing service, update traffic weight, call variant selector, and create rollback PRs when necessary
Audit & explainability: record raw signals, test statistics, and the decision tree trace to persistent storage for postmortem and compliance
Fallback mapping: catalog compatible fallback variants for common model families; allow runtime override via rollout config field 'fallback_candidate'
Observability: surface metric deltas, alert thresholds, and a timeline view in Console; emit structured events to tracing system with correlation_id
